basics.name: Nainesh Rabadiya
basics.label: Technical Lead & Senior Laravel Developer
basics.summary: I am a Technical Lead at WebOccult Technologies, focused on building reliable, high-traffic enterprise applications. I have designed and delivered 5+ large-scale systems, turning complex ideas into scalable and high-performance solutions. My core focus is performance optimization, clean architecture, and mentoring developers. I have successfully delivered 50+ projects, including e-commerce platforms and enterprise systems. I also speak at Laravel meetups in Ahmedabad, where I share practical insights on queue optimization, performance tuning, and Laravel best practices.
